verdict.rationale: Nothing in the evidence pack documents SOC 2 or other compliance attestations, data-handling policies, or datacenter tier certifications for Paperspace. The pack mentions only datacenter regions, team-scoped API keys and machine user access, which are adjacent features, not a verifiable security or compliance posture.

support.subject: As a platform engineer, I can verify the provider's security and compliance posture (SOC 2, data handling, datacenter tiers) before putting proprietary models on it
